verse.text: For God has not given us a spirit of fear and timidity, but of power, love, and self-discipline.

video.title: How to Face Fear | 2 Timothy 1:7 | Our Daily Bread Video Devotional

reflection: Fatherhood will hand you plenty of moments to feel timid — a scary diagnosis, a hard conversation, a budget that doesn't add up — but Paul reminds us that shrinking back isn't the spirit God gave us. Instead He's given you power to act, love to lead gently, and self-discipline to stay steady when everything in you wants to bail. Today, when fear shows up at the dinner table or in your own head, name it, then choose the power, love, and discipline God already placed in you.
